verdict.rationale: Sentry documents rule-based alerts that fire when issues or Monitors match pre-defined rules. These alerts can send notifications, create tickets, or call webhooks, and they route to destinations like Slack, PagerDuty, and Twilio SMS. The evidence covers issue- and monitor-driven alerting only, not alerting on any telemetry signal such as arbitrary traces, logs, or metrics. Grouping and silencing of notifications are not documented. Missing for 10: evidence of alerting on arbitrary telemetry signals (spans/logs/metrics), notification grouping/deduplication controls, silencing/muting/snooze of alerts, independent corroboration.
